user.title: Sign in to HappyParking
user.description:
### [→ Open the HappyParking login page]({login_url})

Sign in there exactly as you always do, with **Kakao** or your **HappyParking id**.

Once you are signed in, copy your login token out of that page and paste it below:

1. Press **F12** to open the browser's developer tools.
2. Go to **Application** → **Local Storage** → `https://app.hparking.co.kr`.
3. Copy the value of **`token`** (a long string of letters and numbers).

Your building's parking server, your app user id and your site code are all read out of that token, so there is nothing else to fill in. The token is used once, here, and is not sent anywhere but your own parking server.

*If your login sent you back to an address containing the token, you can paste that whole address instead.*

*No browser to hand?* Leave the box empty and submit to sign in another way.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in once more for push
reauth_confirm.description:
### [→ Open the HappyParking login page]({login_url})

For push, Home Assistant has to be able to sign itself in again every day. It needs the same thing the app keeps saved on your phone, entered once.

**If you sign in with Kakao**

1. Open the link above in Chrome or Edge on a computer and sign in with Kakao, as you did when you first set this up.
2. Once you are signed in, press **F12**. A developer tools panel opens beside or below the page.
3. Click the **Application** tab at the top of that panel. If you can't see it, click **»** to find it.
4. In the list on the left, expand **Local Storage** and click `https://app.hparking.co.kr`.
5. In the table on the right, find the row named **`providerUserId`** and copy its value (a long number).
6. Paste it into **Kakao id** below and submit. Leave the other two boxes empty.

**If you don't use Kakao**, fill in only **HappyParking id** and **Password**.

This is stored only in Home Assistant and sent only to HappyParking. You won't be asked again.
